criteria.how: Read 04.AC2.md / 04-run.md 'norn brief at implement after send-back N'. The brief names the derived counter exactly when one more send-back makes the unit stuck: with the counter at 3 of 3 it says '**Last round on `review.changes_requested` (3/3):** if the work is sent back along it once more, the unit goes stuck.' At 2 of 3 it shows only 'fix round review.changes_requested 2/3'. The criterion's literal '(2/3)' does not appear; the threshold is unchanged from named counters (same code path). Confirm the user story's intent (warn one lap from stuck, naming the derived counter) is met, or rule that the warning must show at 2/3.
